name: Embu
family: Niger-Congo, Atlantic-Congo, Volta-Congo, Benue-Congo, Bantoid, Southern, Narrow Bantu, Central, E, Kikuyu-Kamba
notes: Embu uses a 7-vowel system where î and û represent [e] and [o], while e and o represent [ɛ] and [ɔ]. Tone is phonemic but not marked in the orthography. The letter ú appears as a likely typo for u or û in the corpus and is mapped to [u]. Decomposed forms of î, û, and ú are included in graphemes to support NFD tokenisation, as the circumflex here denotes vowel quality rather than a predictable diacritic modification.
